translations.english: "Just as food mixed with venom cannot be digested by the great fire (fire of hunger), it is not possible to keep Sita even by gods and demons. (Sita is like food mixed with poison. Ravana cannot digest her with all his power.)
translations.hindi: फिर भ्रतुल तेजस्वी घर्मात्मा श्रीरामचन्द्रजी की पत्नी को जो श्रपने पातिव्रत घमं से सुरक्षित हैं, भ्रग्नि स्पर्श नहीं कर सकता
